name: Self-directed C learning via Antirez's YouTube course

mentions.name: Self-directed C learning via Antirez's YouTube course
mentions.description: A self-directed learning effort: studying the C programming language through Antirez's C course on YouTube. The author, an ERP developer feeling stagnant in their job, is pursuing this education to advance their career and to eventually be able to write Linux tools for personal use instead of working with enterprise code.
mentions.problem: The author's ERP development job is dull and they feel stagnant; they are learning more advanced material to advance their career and to move away from enterprise code.
mentions.audience: The author's own use — advancing their programming career and building personal tools; no broader audience stated.
